services.desc: Once school lets out, the same question lands in every parent's lap: how do you keep a kid active, off the screen and reasonably worn out for two whole months? Two of the most reliable answers are a day camp and steady weekly classes. They're not rivals so much as different tools, and the right pick depends on your summer, not on which one is "better." Here's an honest comparison to help you choose. A summer day camp fills entire days. For a working parent that's the whole point: somewhere safe, structured and genuinely fun for your child while you're at work, with the day broken up between activity, learning and play. A camp week also gives a big burst of energy-burning and new friendships
